item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 10/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect Guangdong today. Under the influence of a fresh to strong easterly airstream, the weather will be dry during the day and mainly fine over the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week to early next week. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea. The easterly airstream is expected to moderate slightly midweek next week.
